claim: Compare ordered port FE values at matched updates and periods at the same OUT; port counts per wall second mix pace with pitch.

evidence.text: Compare ordered FE values at matched updates and periods at the same OUT instruction; port counts per wall second alone mix game pace with pitch.
evidence.quote: Compare ordered FE values at matched updates and periods at the same OUT instruction.

evidence.text: Frame-locked pace hid a slower figure phase: game updates equal, but the beeper plays only while waiting for the interrupt, so port FE writes fell 8 % in busy scenes; the limiter and prepared patterns brought them back (510.4 / 509.6 a second).
evidence.quote: the beeper plays only while waiting for the interrupt, so port FE writes fell 8 % in busy scenes.
